info.title: audio-vue host agent
info.description:
The host agent of an audio-vue panel: its state, its commands, its service, its calibration
runs, its pairing, and its settings: the settings' schema and each card's page, its scenes, its
install settings and its backdrop images.

The state is pushed over the WebSocket `/v1/events`, which OpenAPI cannot describe: each message
is one `State`, sent as it changes and in whole every second, the first on connect. It takes the
token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in its handshake, and refuses the handshake without it.

Every route but `POST /v1/pairing`, `POST /v1/pairing/confirm` and `GET /v1/version` takes the
token. A client is generated from this document, which `make openapi` writes from the code.

A read leaves the display as it is. Every command but `saver` ends the screensaver or sleep,
even when it is refused; `saver` starts the screensaver.

get.description:
The API's version, the state's schema where the panel answers, and the digest of
the code the panel draws with: the running panel's, or where it does not answer the
host's files'. Open, as pairing is: a client reached by address reads it before it
pairs.

The checksum of every entry the code's digest is made from, and each card with the
entry that declares it: the running panel's, or where it does not answer the host's
files', so a client whose digest differs can name each entry and card that does.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

get.description:
The panel's state in its own sections, with its age and the panel's condition.
A panel that does not answer is `down`, and the read succeeds. A read leaves the
display as it is.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Puts a scene from the roster up, and says whether capture was kept or rebuilt and what forced a rebuild. Ends the screensaver or sleep, even when it is refused. A read leaves the display as it is.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Re-reads the scene on screen from where it came from, the store or its file. Ends the screensaver or sleep, even when it is refused. A read leaves the display as it is.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Arms a calibration: the panel listens for the file. A client playing one sets the output's rate and lets the chain settle before it arms, since a wait after the arm spends its deadline, and plays once the arm is done. Ends the screensaver or sleep, even when it is refused. A read leaves the display as it is.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Stops a calibration wherever it has reached. Ends the screensaver or sleep, even when it is refused. A read leaves the display as it is.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Starts the screensaver now. It is the one command that wakes nothing: it does not end the screensaver or sleep.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

get.description: Whether the panel's service runs. Runs `tools/panel.py`, and gives its exit status, what it printed, and the panel's condition after it: a start that lands on the audio-vue screen exits 1 with the panel up.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Starts the panel, recording `scene` first where one is given; with none, what is recorded. A scene that cannot load is refused by name before anything changes. Runs `tools/panel.py`, and gives its exit status, what it printed, and the panel's condition after it: a start that lands on the audio-vue screen exits 1 with the panel up.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Stops the panel until a start or a boot. Runs `tools/panel.py`, and gives its exit status, what it printed, and the panel's condition after it: a start that lands on the audio-vue screen exits 1 with the panel up.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Starts what is recorded again. Runs `tools/panel.py`, and gives its exit status, what it printed, and the panel's condition after it: a start that lands on the audio-vue screen exits 1 with the panel up.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

get.description: What the current run has printed, its last 2,000 lines. Runs `tools/panel.py`, and gives its exit status, what it printed, and the panel's condition after it: a start that lands on the audio-vue screen exits 1 with the panel up.

What the host is: an id that stands across addresses, its name, its display's
size, null unless a running panel says it, and the OS update action running.

The OS's updates on this host: whether the agent may run them, the one running,

post.description: Fetches the OS's package lists, so the update state says what an upgrade would change. Answers at once, and the action runs on: `/v1/host`'s `updating` and the update state say how it goes. One update action runs at a time.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Upgrades every OS package that has an update, finishing an upgrade cut off before, and reboots the host when it succeeds. Refused while a calibration has the panel. Answers at once, and the action runs on: `/v1/host`'s `updating` and the update state say how it goes. One update action runs at a time.

401.description: No token, or a wrong one.

post.description: Reboots the host. Refused while a calibration has the panel. Answers at once, and the action runs on: `/v1/host`'s `updating` and the update state say how it goes. One update action runs at a time.

Uploads a backdrop image as the request's body, a PNG or a JPEG, at most 16 MiB
and 4,096 px a side. Its id is the SHA-256 of its bytes, so the same image twice is
one image. A scene names it by that id.

Analysis.title: Analysis

stated.title: Stated
stated.description: What the run cannot measure, by name, `kind` alone being a word.

Calibration.title: Calibration
Calibration.description: Which reference frame the readings are in.

Capture.title: Capture
Capture.description:
The input, and how old the newest frame is: a growing age with no error is a capture
or an analysis that has hung.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: The SHA-256 of the code manifest: what the cards and the analysis draw with.

from.title: From
from.description: `panel`, the running panel's; or `host`, the host's files', where the panel does not answer.

from.title: From
from.description: `panel`, the running panel's; or `host`, the host's files', where the panel does not answer.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: The SHA-256 of `entries`, the version's `cards` digest.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Each card directory, module and font by its repository path, and its SHA-256.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Each card the roster declares, placeable or not, and the key in `entries` of the card directory that declares it.

Checked.title: Checked
Checked.description: Every failure the document has, none where it passes.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Capture devices, as ALSA names them.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the list is empty, where it is.

Display.title: Display
Display.description: Who has the display, its size, and the idle stages in force.

Draft.title: Draft
Draft.description: A document to check, which nothing stores.

base_rev.title: Base Rev
base_rev.description: The revision this edit was made from; 0 for an install block never written.

Failure.title: Failure
Failure.description:
One thing wrong with a document: where, the empty place being the document itself,
and what.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: What the health strip shows, highest severity first.

width_px.title: Width Px
width_px.description: Null unless a running panel says it.

updating.title: Updating
updating.description: The OS update action running, null where none is or the host manages none.

Image.title: Image
Image.description: An image a scene may name: an upload, with its format and size, or a shipped one.

Install.title: Install
Install.description: Each install block that failed validation and runs on its defaults, with why.

InstallBlock.title: InstallBlock
InstallBlock.description: An install block: revision 0 and an empty document where it is on its defaults.

chain_changed.title: Chain Changed
chain_changed.description: The chain settings this write changed.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.description: What a chain change does to calibration.

exit_code.title: Exit Code
exit_code.description: The restart's exit status, where it ran.

text.title: Text
text.description: What the restart printed, where it ran.

InstallWritten.title: InstallWritten
InstallWritten.description:
An install block stored. With no chain setting changed it applies when the panel next
starts, or for the type sizes (`fonts`) when it next builds a scene, by a reload or a switch.
A chain change restarts a running panel and leaves a stopped one stopped.

Invalid.title: Invalid
Invalid.description: A document that fails validation, with every failure.

result.title: Result
result.description: systemd's: `success`, else how it ended, such as `exit-code` or `timeout`.

LastAction.title: LastAction
LastAction.description: The last check or upgrade, which a host back from an upgrade's reboot still gives.

OffStandard.title: OffStandard
OffStandard.description: A measurement setting on screen whose value its standard does not define.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description: What became of a command: its `reason` where it was not done, else its result.

installed.title: Installed
installed.description: Null for a package an upgrade would add.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: Null for one it would remove.

Package.title: Package
Package.description: One package an upgrade would change.

Pairing.title: Pairing
Pairing.description: Whether a pairing code is showing. Never the code.

code.title: Code
code.description: The six digits the panel shows.

ttl_s.title: Ttl S
ttl_s.description: How long the code on the panel stands.

tries.title: Tries
tries.description: Wrong codes allowed before it is withdrawn.

rev.title: Rev
rev.description: The kept revision whose content becomes the next revision.

Revisions.title: Revisions
Revisions.description: A document's kept earlier revisions, newest first.

Run.title: Run
Run.description: Where the run is: `phase` is `starting`, `waiting`, `holding` or `drawing`.

Scene.title: Scene
Scene.description:
The scene on screen, by what a switch takes (`spec`): a built-in's name or a stored
scene's id.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.description: A built-in for a process, the calibration scene: not offered to pick or duplicate, and refused as a copy.

rev.title: Rev
rev.description: A stored scene's current revision; null for a built-in.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.description: A built-in for a process, the calibration scene: not offered to pick or duplicate, and refused as a copy.

rev.title: Rev
rev.description: A stored scene's current revision; null for a built-in.

SceneSummary.title: SceneSummary
SceneSummary.description:
A scene on the roster: a built-in by its name, or a stored scene by the id the host
gave it. `name` is what a client shows.

analysis_changed.title: Analysis Changed
analysis_changed.description: Whether the `analysis` block changed, so putting it up may rebuild capture and restart history.

SceneWritten.title: SceneWritten
SceneWritten.description: A scene stored. The scene on screen takes it on a reload or a switch, never before.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: What `tools/panel.py` said, and the panel's condition after it.

Stale.title: Stale
Stale.description: A write based on a revision the document has moved on from.

scene.title: Scene
scene.description: A scene to record and start, a built-in's name or a stored scene's id; none restarts what is recorded.

Started.title: Started
Started.description: Whether an update action started. It runs on after the answer.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The state's schema, null where nothing answers.

since.title: Since
since.description: When the panel last answered, UTC, ISO 8601.

State.title: State
State.description:
The panel's state with its condition. Down, the sections are empty and `since` is when
the panel last answered.

scene.title: Scene
scene.description: A scene on the panel's roster: a built-in's name or a stored scene's id.

action.title: Action
action.description: The action running, or the last one.

text.title: Text
text.description: Its output's last lines, the newest last.

granted.title: Granted
granted.description: Whether the agent may run them here.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why not, where it may not.

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: When the last check that succeeded ended, UTC, ISO 8601.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: What an upgrade would do, by the package lists the last check fetched.

Updates.title: Updates
Updates.description: The OS's updates on this host. audio-vue's own are not among them.

id.title: Id
id.description: The image's id: the SHA-256 of its bytes, then `.png` or `.jpg`.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The state's schema, null where the panel does not answer.

cards.description: The digest of the code the panel draws scenes with.
